segments.context: Onyx Coffee Lab · United StatesTropical WeatherTropical Weather is a worthwhile first bag for a US buyer who deliberately wants a lighter Ethiopian blend with berry and tea cues and can dial separately for filter and espresso. Onyx documents the two processing styles and offers method guidance, but the microlots rotate. Buy it for that changing fruit-led direction, not a promised copy of an older reviewer's cup.Updated 2026-11-09 · Check current US whole-bean price at November 9, 2026
